name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor for a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor for a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a design-build contractor, gather an updated property survey or plot plan, identify structural pain points in your current kitchen, and list must-have appliances. Check for exterior obstructions where the addition will sit, such as underground utility lines, mature trees, or air conditioning compressors. Having a clear idea of your appliance sizes, storage priorities, and overall investment range allows your contractor to draft realistic preliminary layouts right away.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify layout pain points, make an appliance wishlist, and note any exterior obstacles in the planned build zone.
